title: IGP: Efficient Multi-Vector Retrieval via Proximity Graph Index
venue: Proceedings of the 48th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR '25)
version_status: Formal bibliography verified against Crossref and author-hosted conference manuscript; author PDF revision identifier and arXiv version unverified

classification.original_problem: Approximate multi-vector retrieval with ColBERT sum-of-MaxSim inner-product scoring
classification.relative_to_vector_join: B: 可迁移借鉴；不是几何vector join，也不直接支持目录DSQ
classification.relative_to_current_directory_DSQ: Adjacent retrieval task; transfer compression representation and offline preparation, not multi-vector candidate aggregation or scoring

method.compression_source: ColBERTv2, explicitly adopted in sections 3.2 and 4
method.representation: Float32 coarse centroids + uint32 centroid ID per vector + bit-packed residual scalar quantization; shared quantile cutoffs and reconstruction weights across dimensions and centroids
method.graph_vertices: Float32 coarse centroids, not all document vectors or their quantization codes
method.refinement: Reconstruct candidate vectors from lossy codes then compute sum-of-MaxSim; not exact reranking against original FP32 vectors
method.cpu_search_storage: Compressed codes and metadata plus coarse float centroids and per-thread reconstructed-candidate workspaces; raw FP32 corpus remains an offline disk input, not a required loaded search-index argument
method.gpu_offline: K-means and centroid assignment in common pipeline; separate CUDA residual-encoding implementation exists; cutoff/weight quantile training is CPU in examined code

guarantees.all_vector_HNSW_build_speedup_from_quant: 未提供；IGP graph is on centroids
guarantees.full_paper_theory: 未完整核查；Theorem 1 ideal next-similar order does not establish a DSQ or quantized-HNSW recall bound

experiments.paper_results_checked: Section 5.3 Table 7 reports the cost breakdown for its multi-vector workload; no performance number transferred to current single-vector DSQ

evidence.supports: GPU K-means, centroid normalization and IP assignment
shared quantile SQ, packing and non-renormalized reconstruction
loaded index state, graph-build timing boundary, working memory and scoring
